paper_title: An Alkylated Indacenodithieno[3,2-b]thiophene-Based Nonfullerene Acceptor with High Crystallinity Exhibiting Single Junction Solar Cell Efficiencies Greater than 13% with Low Voltage Losses

qa_pairs.question: What are the specific photovoltaic performance parameters of the organic solar cell based on the PFBDB-T/C8-ITIC blend?
qa_pairs.answer: The PFBDB-T/C8-ITIC blend-based organic solar cell achieved a maximum power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 13.2%. The associated performance metrics include an open-circuit voltage (Voc) of 0.94 V, a short-circuit current (Jsc) of 19.6 mA cm^-2, and a fill factor (FF) of 0.72.
qa_pairs.source_title: An Alkylated Indacenodithieno[3,2-b]thiophene-Based Nonfullerene Acceptor with High Crystallinity Exhibiting Single Junction Solar Cell Efficiencies Greater than 13% with Low Voltage Losses

qa_pairs.question: How does the side chain engineering in C8-ITIC affect its optical properties compared to the original ITIC molecule?
qa_pairs.answer: Replacing the phenylalkyl side chains in ITIC with linear octyl side chains in C8-ITIC results in a red-shifted absorption maximum, reaching 738 nm in the film state. Additionally, C8-ITIC exhibits a higher molar extinction coefficient of 2.05 x 10^5 M^-1 cm^-1 compared to 1.72 x 10^5 M^-1 cm^-1 for ITIC.
qa_pairs.source_title: An Alkylated Indacenodithieno[3,2-b]thiophene-Based Nonfullerene Acceptor with High Crystallinity Exhibiting Single Junction Solar Cell Efficiencies Greater than 13% with Low Voltage Losses

qa_pairs.question: Describe the synthetic process used to create the indacenodithieno[3,2-b]thiophene (IDTT) core for C8-ITIC.
qa_pairs.answer: The synthesis involves a novel route starting with the base-catalyzed rearrangement of an indacenodithiophene (IDT) monomer to form IDT-dicarbaldehyde. This intermediate is then treated with ethyl mercaptoacetate under basic conditions to produce the IDTT-dicarboxylate core.
qa_pairs.source_title: An Alkylated Indacenodithieno[3,2-b]thiophene-Based Nonfullerene Acceptor with High Crystallinity Exhibiting Single Junction Solar Cell Efficiencies Greater than 13% with Low Voltage Losses

qa_pairs.question: What are the energy levels of the fluorinated polymer PFBDB-T, and how do they compare to its non-fluorinated counterpart?
qa_pairs.answer: The fluorinated polymer PFBDB-T has a HOMO level of -5.47 eV and a LUMO level of -3.46 eV. These levels are deeper than those of the non-fluorinated version (PBDB-T).
qa_pairs.source_title: An Alkylated Indacenodithieno[3,2-b]thiophene-Based Nonfullerene Acceptor with High Crystallinity Exhibiting Single Junction Solar Cell Efficiencies Greater than 13% with Low Voltage Losses

qa_pairs.question: How does the fluorination of the donor polymer backbone contribute to the reduction of voltage losses in PFBDB-T/C8-ITIC devices?
qa_pairs.answer: Fluorination reduces voltage loss through two mechanisms: first, it lowers the HOMO and LUMO levels of the donor, which reduces the energetic offset with the acceptor and results in a steeper absorption edge (reducing ΔVoc,abs). Second, it leads to a reduction in nonradiative recombination loss (ΔVoc,nr), which reaches a minimum of 0.33 V in the PFBDB-T/C8-ITIC system.
qa_pairs.source_title: An Alkylated Indacenodithieno[3,2-b]thiophene-Based Nonfullerene Acceptor with High Crystallinity Exhibiting Single Junction Solar Cell Efficiencies Greater than 13% with Low Voltage Losses

qa_pairs.question: Compare the total energy loss (Eg/q - Voc) of the PFBDB-T/C8-ITIC device to the PBDB-T/ITIC device.
qa_pairs.answer: The total energy loss for the PFBDB-T/C8-ITIC device is approximately 0.60 eV, which is significantly lower than the 0.68 eV observed in the PBDB-T/ITIC device.
qa_pairs.source_title: An Alkylated Indacenodithieno[3,2-b]thiophene-Based Nonfullerene Acceptor with High Crystallinity Exhibiting Single Junction Solar Cell Efficiencies Greater than 13% with Low Voltage Losses

qa_pairs.question: In terms of molecular packing and crystallinity, what advantages does C8-ITIC show over ITIC according to GIWAXS analysis?
qa_pairs.answer: GIWAXS analysis shows that C8-ITIC has a higher propensity to form ordered 3D structures, evidenced by sharp diffraction spots along horizontal, vertical, and off-axis directions. In contrast, ITIC only crystallizes along the three principle crystallographic axes in its as-cast state. Furthermore, C8-ITIC is able to retain some molecular order (a peak at q ≈ 0.36 Å^-1) even when blended with a donor polymer, whereas ITIC's crystallization is more heavily suppressed.
qa_pairs.source_title: An Alkylated Indacenodithieno[3,2-b]thiophene-Based Nonfullerene Acceptor with High Crystallinity Exhibiting Single Junction Solar Cell Efficiencies Greater than 13% with Low Voltage Losses

qa_pairs.question: What effect does the introduction of an In2O3 layer have on the ZnO interface and the resulting solar cell performance?
qa_pairs.answer: The introduction of an In2O3 layer between the ITO and ZnO layers reduces the surface roughness of the ZnO from 1.44 nm to 0.84 nm. This smoothing of the interface improves the device's fill factor (FF) and enhances the reproducibility of the solar cells.
qa_pairs.source_title: An Alkylated Indacenodithieno[3,2-b]thiophene-Based Nonfullerene Acceptor with High Crystallinity Exhibiting Single Junction Solar Cell Efficiencies Greater than 13% with Low Voltage Losses
